plugins.name: App Usage

settings_fields.label: Enable App Usage Sync
settings_fields.description: Tracks the foreground app every second and writes one summary per app for each clock hour (10:00-11:00, 11:00-12:00, ...). A bucket is only written to your timeline after the hour it belongs to has fully ended, so the first entry typically appears 0-59 minutes after you enable this.

settings_fields.label: Check Interval
settings_fields.description: How often the plugin checks for hourly buckets that have just ended and flushes them to the timeline. This does NOT change how often new entries appear (always one per app per clock hour); a smaller value only reduces the delay between an hour ending and its records becoming visible.

plugins.description: Tracks which apps you use and for how long, helping Magi understand your work focus, productivity patterns, and daily habits. Records are aggregated by clock hour, so the first entries appear on your timeline only after the current hour ends.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 记录各应用的使用时长，帮助 Magi 了解你的工作专注情况、效率规律和日常使用习惯。数据按整点小时聚合，第一条记录会在当前所在的整点小时结束后才出现在时间线上。

settings_fields.label: Active window interval (sec)
settings_fields.description: How often to capture the active window. Recommended: 10s.

settings_fields.label: App blocklist (bundle IDs)
settings_fields.description: Bundle IDs to never capture. Glob patterns supported (e.g. com.example.*). Defaults block known password managers and the macOS SecurityAgent; remove entries to allow them.

settings_fields.label: Capture scope
settings_fields.description: What part of the screen to capture each tick.

settings_fields.label: Enabled
settings_fields.description: Whether the screenshot timeline sensor is active.

settings_fields.label: Full-screen interval (min)
settings_fields.description: Periodic full-screen capture interval (used in hybrid or full_screen modes).

settings_fields.label: OCR languages
settings_fields.description: Apple Vision recognition language codes (BCP-47), e.g. zh-Hans, en-US, ja. Order matters: the first language is the primary character-set hypothesis. If your screen content is mostly Chinese with code/URLs mixed in, keep zh-Hans first; English-only users can put en-US first.

settings_fields.label: OCR recognition level
settings_fields.description: Apple Vision text-recognition precision tier. "Accurate" uses a neural network — handles small fonts, mixed-language text, and dense UI; ~0.5–2s per screenshot. "Fast" uses traditional character recognition — 5-10× faster but small fonts, CJK characters, and busy UI degrade quickly. Keep "Accurate" unless CPU is an issue.

settings_fields.label: Original retention (days)
settings_fields.description: Originals older than this are deleted. Thumbnails are kept permanently.

settings_fields.label: Window title blocklist (substrings)
settings_fields.description: Any window whose title contains any of these strings will be skipped.

settings_actions.label: System permissions
settings_actions.description: Check Screen Recording (required) and Accessibility (optional, for window titles and structured text) permissions. macOS will prompt if not yet granted.

settings_resources.description: Live macOS permission grants required by the screenshot timeline plugin.

settings_ui_blocks.title: macOS Permissions
settings_ui_blocks.description: Screen Recording is required for capture. Accessibility is optional, and provides window titles and structured on-screen text.

activation_flow.title: Enable Screenshot Timeline
activation_flow.description:
This plugin continuously captures your screen and runs local OCR (via Apple Vision) to feed the recognised text into magi's memory. Captures and thumbnails stay on this Mac — they are not uploaded anywhere. Originals are deleted after 30 days by default; thumbnails are kept indefinitely.

Password managers, Keychain, and incognito browser windows are skipped by default. You can add more app or window-title rules in Settings after enabling.

macOS will ask for Screen Recording permission the first time captures start. Accessibility permission provides window titles and structured on-screen text.

plugins.description: Local-only screen capture (opt-in, off by default): extracts on-screen text into magi's memory. Captures stay on your Mac, are never uploaded, and auto-delete after 30 days.
